uses: how ElementsDelta tests build maps and apply deltas

acceptance: normalizeStyleRanges clamps, drops empty or colourless ranges and sorts: given ranges [{start:8,end:99,strokeColor:'#f00'},{start:2,end:2,strokeColor:'#0f0'},{start:-3,end:2,backgroundColor:'#ff0'},{start:4,end:6}] for textLength 10, expect [{start:0,end:2,backgroundColor:'#ff0'},{start:8,end:10,strokeColor:'#f00'}]
normalizeStyleRanges merges adjacent and overlapping same-style ranges: given [{0,3,red},{3,5,red},{4,8,red}], expect [{start:0,end:8,strokeColor:red}]
normalizeStyleRanges lets later entries win inside an overlap: given [{0,6,strokeColor:red},{3,9,strokeColor:blue}] for textLength 10, expect [{0,3,red},{3,9,blue}]
normalizeStyleRanges returns undefined when nothing remains: given undefined, [] and [{start:1,end:1,strokeColor:red}], expect undefined for each

applyStyleToRange over part of a range splits it: given ranges [{0,10,strokeColor:red}], applying {strokeColor:blue} to [3,6) with textLength 10 and base '#1e1e1e', expect [{0,3,red},{3,6,blue},{6,10,red}]

applyStyleToRange keeps the other property and fills gaps: given ranges [{2,4,strokeColor:red}], applying {backgroundColor:yellow} to [0,6), expect [{0,2,bg yellow},{2,4,red + bg yellow},{4,6,bg yellow}]

applyStyleToRange clears with the base colour or transparent: given ranges [{0,5,strokeColor:red,backgroundColor:yellow}], applying {strokeColor:'#1e1e1e'} with base '#1e1e1e', then {backgroundColor:'transparent'}, expect first [{0,5,backgroundColor:yellow}], then undefined
shiftStyleRangesForEdit on insert before, inside and after a range: given range [{4,7,red}] on 'abcdefghij'; insert 'XY' at 0, at 5, and at 9, expect [{6,9}], [{4,9}], [{4,7}] respectively
shiftStyleRangesForEdit does not colour text typed at a range's edges: given range [{4,7,red}] on 'abcdefghij'; insert 'X' at 4, then (separately) at 7, expect [{5,8}] and [{4,7}]
shiftStyleRangesForEdit on delete before, overlapping and inside: given range [{4,7,red}] on 'abcdefghij'; delete [0,2), delete [3,5), delete [5,6), expect [{2,5}], [{3,5}], [{4,6}]
deleting a range's text entirely drops it: given range [{4,7,red}] on 'abcdefghij'; delete [3,8), expect undefined

shiftStyleRangesForEdit uses the caret to place an ambiguous insertion: given range [{0,2,red}] on 'aa'; next text 'aaa' with caret 1 and with caret 3, expect [{0,3,red}] with caret 1, and [{0,2,red}] with caret 3

getStyleRunsForLines splits a single line into runs: given originalText 'Bid request timeout 120ms', the same text as wrappedText, range [{20,25,red}], expect [[{text:'Bid request timeout '},{text:'120ms',strokeColor:red}]]

getStyleRunsForLines follows soft wraps and trimmed spaces: given the sample text wrapped with wrapText(text, font, 100), range [{12,25,red}] covering 'timeout 120ms', expect each line's runs concatenate to the line; the run texts carrying red concatenate to 'timeout120ms'; the 'Bid' and 'request' lines have no coloured run

getStyleRunsForLines keeps hard line breaks and empty lines aligned: given originalText 'ab\n\ncd' (wrapped text identical), range [{4,5,red}], expect [[{text:'ab'}],[],[{text:'c',strokeColor:red},{text:'d'}]]

runs survive a bound-text container's wrapping: given a rectangle of width 120 and a bound text with the sample text and range [{20,25,red}], wrapped with wrapText(originalText, font, getBoundTextMaxWidth(container, text)), expect the last wrapped line's runs are [{text:'120ms',strokeColor:red}]

runs survive a font change that re-wraps the same text: given the font-size-scaled metrics provider; the sample text wrapped at maxWidth 200 with a 10px font and with a 20px font, range [{20,25,red}], expect the two wraps differ in line count, and in both the coloured runs concatenate to '120ms'

getTextStyleRunLayout positions runs by measured prefix widths: given a text 'hello world' of width 200 with range [{6,11,red}], textAlign left, then center, expect left: runs at x 0 (width 60) and x 60 (width 50); center: x 45 and x 105
getTextStyleRunLayout is null without ranges or for RTL text: given a text without styleRanges, and an RTL text 'שלום עולם' with a range, expect null for both

sanitizeStyleRanges keeps only well-formed entries: given [null, 3, [], {start:NaN,end:2,strokeColor:red}, {start:0,end:1.5,strokeColor:red}, {start:0,end:2}, {start:0,end:2,strokeColor:5}, {start:1,end:3,strokeColor:red,extra:true}] for textLength 10, expect [{start:1,end:3,strokeColor:red}] with no extra key; a non-array value gives undefined

undo restores the previous ranges and redo re-applies them: given a text with no styleRanges (before) and the same text via newElementWith with [{0,4,red}] (after); delta = ElementsDelta.calculate(before, after), expect delta.inverse() applied to after gives styleRanges undefined; delta applied to before gives [{0,4,red}]; both report a visible change

an equal-content styleRanges change is not recorded: given a text with [{0,4,red}] and newElementWith(text, { styleRanges: [{0,4,red}] }) as a fresh array, expect the calculated delta's updated entry has no styleRanges key
